items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: the first band that Miles Davis played with was Eddie Randall's band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh, yes, we almost starved to death the first summer we were here. There's a bandleader here

named Eddie Randall, Eddie Randall is -- is -- is the bandleader that Miles Davis -- the first band that Miles Davis played with was Eddie Randall's band. Eddie Randall's the type of fella that he's been very kind to musicians. He was very broadminded, a big person. And Eddie had a small band and he had bought a seven-passenger Chrysler and he was popular in all the little small towns out here.
